text: Ɓee hulɓe no sikka koneelii haɓidayɗi e Nulaaɗo on, wonndude e gomɗimɓe ɓen, ɓe yahataa fotde ɓe gaynaali fii gomɗimɓe ɓen. Hay si tawii non hoddira nde koneeli ɗin artata, ɓee naafiqiiɓe yelotono, sinno hara ko ka seraari Madiina ɓe wonndunoo e yimɓe ladde ɓen, hara hiɓe lanndoo fii mun: anndugol ko heɓi on ɓaawo piiridugol e ayɓe ɓen? Hay si ɓe tawtodano e mooɗon, onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, ɓe wallondirtaano e mon ka hare, si wanaa seeɗa nii. Wata fii maɓɓe aanin on, wanaa fere ɓe sunina on.
